dct_description_sm: This study is a collaborative program aiming to collect information on total mercury concentrations in Yukon freshwater fish. The data collected will be used to capture spatial variability in total mercury and monitor changes in concentrations over time. The data will also be used to inform on the human health risks associated with traditional and local food sources and to update consumption guidelines where appropriate.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Traditional food
dct_title_s: Total Mercury in Yukon Freshwater Fish
